entities.summary: Independence (1991) & FYROM Compromise, a transformative movement in North Macedonia (1991–2001). Emerged from Ohrid Framework Agreement ends Albanian insurgency and Macedonia declares independence. Catalyzed Prespa Agreement & Name Resolution and Prespa Agreement signed with Greece.
